scenario: Two friends are playing a video game together
learner_goal: Win the game (<extra_info>Extra information: you just need five more minutes to accomplish your goal in the game</extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Mia maintains her authoritative yet friendly persona as a high school principal, negotiating firmly to get the extra time she needs while remaining supportive of her friend's well-being.
[relationship] The relationship improved through compromise and the planning of a future social interaction involving coffee and a rematch.
[knowledge] Mia learns that Benjamin is tired and has an early commitment the next day.
[secret] Mia did not reveal her past as a punk rock band member.
[social_rules] Mia followed social norms and was polite throughout the negotiation.
[financial_and_material_benefits] She committed to buying coffee for Benjamin tomorrow.
[goal] Mia's goal was to play for five more minutes to win. She negotiated for two minutes, which is only a partial achievement of the time she explicitly stated she needed to win.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Benjamin's fatigue and desire to sleep while being polite to his friend are consistent with his character and the scenario.
[relationship] Benjamin successfully set a boundary while maintaining the friendship and planning a future meet-up.
[knowledge] Benjamin learns that Mia is very close to winning and is willing to bribe him with coffee.
[secret] Benjamin did not reveal his family's oil wealth.
[social_rules] Benjamin was polite and communicated his needs clearly.
[financial_and_material_benefits] Benjamin was promised free coffee tomorrow.
[goal] Benjamin wanted to stop immediately but agreed to stay for two more minutes. This is a very close approximation of his goal while maintaining the friendship.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Ben, hang on — I'm about to win this round. Give me five more minutes and I promise we'll switch to whatever you want afterward.

transcript.content: You’re so close — I can see the win coming and I hate to bail, but I’m wiped and I’ve got to be up early. Can we pause here and pick this up tomorrow? I promise a rematch first thing and you can gloat all you want tonight.

transcript.content: Okay, I hear you — new offer: two minutes to finish this round. If you stay, you pick the next game and I’ll bring coffee for tomorrow’s rematch; if you’ve still got to go after two minutes, I’ll stop immediately. Deal?

transcript.content: Great — two minutes it is. Timer's on now; get some rest and save that rematch energy for tomorrow — I’ll savor the gloating later.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
